name: design-review
description: A gated design-vitality pipeline that makes 'looks generic' a failing, machine-checkable verdict: it studies real current references live, runs 4 third-party design skills as routed read-only lenses (each driven by a source-verified playbook), and ends every run with an explicit alive/templated/flat verdict. One owner decision per run (a multi-select of findings); ships /design-review:run, 8 agents, a preflight manifest, and an enforcement hook.
